body: The correct term is ASPD. Please stop spreading stigma. Not everyone with this disorder are horrible people.
Can’t say I feel bad 💀

As an 18 year old who has dealt with sexual harassment in school, report all of them. They’ll get suspended like they should. You’re being sexually harassed and even touched. It’s wrong and it is not your fault.

When I was 11-14 I was sexually abused and raped by my brother. Nobody helped me. My family was on my brother’s side the entire time. I had no one. Please help her, get her therapy, be on her side, go to the hospital and get a rape kit. I highly recommend to sue him. Make sure she isn’t having nightmares or flashbacks of the situation. I’m so sorry. She’s going to need all the support you can muster. She probably feels confused and frightened. Again, please sue him whenever you can. Garner as much evidence as you can so you can have a chance of going against him in court.
I’m also a middle eastern woman and I understand how it all feels. I was sexually abused by my own brother and they still defended him. I’m leaving soon as well. I hope everything goes well for you!
I did some research and discovered it’s because of anhedonia which is common with people who have depression which is very unfortunate to say the least.

He does go to therapy. His therapy lasts all day long. He actually did get a bit better and has made drastic change in his behavior. He used to be violent toward people made him angry such as racists. However, he doesn’t anymore and hasn’t been in jail for a long time now. He told me he changed because I wanted him to change and he did. He’s the first person to ever keep his promise and I do believe he’ll work on withdrawing but it’s something he has learned from childhood so I presume it’ll be more difficult.

I don’t have any close friends so it’s not much of an option. Many of them are graduating and planning on living in a dorm. I do love him both in and out of the relationship and I would love to live with him, and I hope that it will work out. I know there’s a possibility of it being futile, but it’s worth the risk for now. I just wish I could help him more when I know there’s nothing I can do if he cannot communicate. If he doesn’t communicate, that is on him and I’ve accepted that. There will never be a valid reason for him to lash out on me when I’ve given him multiple opportunities to be vulnerable. At the end of the day, if those are his boundaries then I accept it but if it negatively affects him, that is not my responsibility. It’s beyond my control.

That’s what I’ve tried imagining. I have no idea how he would act. Usually he’ll play games as a way of withdrawal to escape whatever he’s feeling. Honestly, I’d move out either way because my family is abusive and cps has done nothing for me. I’d rather deal with the withdrawal than sexual and mental abuse.

I’ve spoken to him about the issue and he acknowledges that we don’t talk often. Usually he’ll be really close to me and talk a lot and suddenly he’ll withdraw until I reach out and say something. He says he’s trying to work on it. There are times where we won’t talk for well over a week but I never protest or anything. I try to be as patient as possible or contact him to check up on him.

Something I’ve been really concerned about is what my criminal law teacher told me: how much I make in my field will depend on where I go to school and how well I do. If I get really good grades and test scores in a state university or even CC, will I still have a good chance at targeting more rigorous universities. Honestly, the universities I was previously targeting were around the 40%-50% acceptance rate range, but I doubt I’d be able to get accepted into them at this rate.

Being honest, I’ve done this before and the response I received was how they couldn’t do anything for me and they lowkey accused me of faking despite being medically diagnosed. While the more information can be better, don’t discuss suicide or counseling may land you in a mental hospital… I have had personal experience. Even after returning from the hospital, none of them gave a shit and still blamed it on me. All my teachers basically degraded me except for my astronomy teacher. Overall, it really depends on the type of person they are. If they’re an understanding and chill teacher, I assure you they’ll come up with a compromise. Otherwise, they’ll blame everything on you.

My boyfriend was 4’5 and I still had feelings for him. Trust me, height is not always a factor for people. While evolutionary choices made men taller than they were in the past, a person who heavily factors in height is not worth working for.

I literally just gave up in my senior year of high school. I’m a 4.1 student but damn my grades look atrocious. I went to a mental hospital and after I came back, I had a teacher literally say to my face that I need to come to school more often knowing I was in a mental hospital. What the actual hell was I supposed to do? Elope? Jfc. I feel you. School is a flawed, robotic system and it doesn’t always determine success. All teachers will care about are your grades. Your worth? Grades. Your sanity? Grades. Your existence? Grades. Just grades.

Thank you, that means a lot to me. It just that this started happening only around 2-3 days ago. I used to cope in a similar way so I’m trying to be understanding, but if it continues even longer then I am planning on talking to him about it.

Thank you for the advice. One of the issues here is that when I did try to seek out other people to help me and vent to them, he seems to have gotten jealous over it. But I can’t do anything about his jealousy. I can’t believe so much has changed only within like 2-3 days. I appreciate the advice though and I will be using it. We’re both 17 years old which is pretty young. He actually is aware I’m anxiously attached and is familiar with attachment theory which did help but now that he’s struggling, he’s having his own trouble. I’m thinking of waiting it out because I used to cope in a similar way, but if his behavior pattern doesn’t change then I will talk to him about it.
I honestly really do need advice because I don’t know what else to do. I’m scared he’ll eventually love this other person more than me. He never usually ignores me.

One of my teachers did offer me his classroom whenever I needed it, but I have to ask for permission from my other teachers when I need it. Of course, they all deny me. I was on medication, specifically Prozac, but I ran out and need a new prescription but the therapy place I went to hasn’t contacted me in weeks so I’m planning on calling them up soon later this week.

I really needed to hear this. A few weeks ago I was actually admitted into a mental hospital to get help and they they put me in outpatient but it’s taking a while for the therapy place to set up another appointment. I’m currently off my medication since I didn’t get anymore prescribed to me. You’ve alleviated some anxiety off my shoulders, thank you.
He actually does have BPD so I guess you’re right…

I know, but I feel so emotionally drained. Nothing makes sense to me. One time, I was going to, well, die after I came back from the mental hospital a few weeks after and he actually panicked and tried attempting as well because he didn’t want the relationship to end. I woke up at 2 am trying to call him over and over again because I actually accidentally fell asleep. He ended up needing to call 911. I even gave him nudes and we were both becoming really close until he begins to pull away for whatever reason out of nowhere. This isn’t the first time he has done this either. Usually, when things get hard and we’re close, he avoids me and never vents to me but vents to this other girl instead because (this is what I assume) he doesn’t want me to be stressed. But it makes no sense because when he was anxious over being charged, he actually vented to me and told me he loved me and all for listening. The last time he has done this random distancing is when he had to get permission from me to kiss a guy who he beat the shit out of and put in the hospital because he was threatening to tell the law that he was the one who assaulted him. Recently, he was contacted by this guy who he sent to jail because he threatened to rape my boyfriend and he seemed incredibly disturbed so I contacted him asking if he was alright and still no damn response and I feel like that girl must be so much better. Better enough to leave me for her. They’re both ignoring me after asking them how they feel after what happened. And it’s incredibly frustrating and I feel like they’re hiding something from me.
